ambient_events: The landing circle's marker lights breathe a slow, patient red.
The windsock snaps toward the bay and goes slack again.
A bay door runs down its track somewhere behind you and seals.
Wind scours straight across the open deck and off into the dark.
description: The crown of the tower, given over to one circle of non-slip deck ringed in recessed landing lights, cantilevered clear of the parapet so there is nothing under its outer edge but four hundred feet of grey air. A lit windsock stands at the northern rail. Two glass-doored bays are set back into the crown behind the pad, deep enough to swallow a light rotorcraft each and roll the doors down on it. A refuelling point sits flush in the deck under a brass cover. The wind up here is clean and constant, and it arrives without asking. Step in to the elevator.

flags.residents_only_deny: The panel by the pad door reads your hand, finds no residence attached to it, and stays shut. Somewhere below, a concierge is already deciding not to mention it.

name: Solenne Sky Pad
